firm_data.firm_description: Arshack, Hajek & Lehrman, PLLC is a New York-based law firm specializing in criminal defense, civil rights protection, complex civil litigation, medical malpractice, and insurance defense. They represent individuals and businesses in New York and throughout the world.
notable_facts: They have offices in Manhattan and London.
The firm defends individuals and businesses in New York and throughout the world, from state trial courts to the US Supreme Court to the United Nations.

email.subject: AI for Arshack, Hajek & Lehrman - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Daniel,

Your work in criminal defense and civil rights protection from state courts to the Supreme Court tells me you're handling the most complex, high-stakes cases. That requires precision at every stage, and I suspect your team is doing more manual work than ideal.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
